## Summary

**Normalize panel titles and operator vocabulary**

Monitor/Track/Inspect/Review prefixes and long questions inflate titles.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P1**
- Wave: **V2**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P1-03`
- DUX code: `DUX5-12`

## Scope

All dashboards.

Screenshot groups: SG-01..SG-07 titles

## Concrete change

Use noun phrase or short operator question; move scope to badge and action verbs to buttons.

## Expected effect

Panel titles become scannable and fit two lines.

## Acceptance criteria

- No required title exceeds two lines at 1366 px; action verbs appear only on actions.
- Aligns with epic acceptance: Status/Reason/Impact/Action visible without internal scroll on first viewport
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic introduced only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Copy style guide.

## Risk

Renaming may affect search/bookmarks only if titles are externally referenced.

## Overlap / predecessor notes

Title/copy normalization after DUX4-01 title harness.

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON only; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Run Explorer remains forensic owner when moving detail off domain boards
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; keep first-screen copy to 2-4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots for affected panels (dark theme)
- [ ] Viewports: 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 at 100% (125% when layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest for navigation/contracts if JSON structure changes
- [ ] Manual operator 5-second comprehension check on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX5 epic (#7116)
